title: Graph machine learning identifies polymer gas-separation membranes
summary: A graph-based machine-learning model ranked polymer candidates; two were synthesized and measured above selected empirical permeability–selectivity upper bounds for O2/N2, H2/CH4 and H2/N2. The bounds are historical empirical comparisons, not physical limits; the study does not demonstrate industrial mixed-gas performance. The claim here is bounded to the primary arXiv v1, which reports the synthesized candidates.

evidence.tested: Two synthesized candidates reported above selected empirical upper bounds in specified gas pairs.
evidence.unknown: Exact journal/preprint result correspondence and prior structure-level art not exhaustively checked.
evidence.ai_role: Graph ML predicts permeability/selectivity from polymer structure and prioritizes candidates for synthesis and testing.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
